resources.string: Import the .p12 or .pfx file and password from your SBC administrator. Keep the SIP password in your account settings.
A certificate is stored for this account. Fully close and reopen MyTel if it is still using an earlier connection.
Optional. If your SBC requires mTLS, import its .p12 or .pfx file before connecting and select TLS under Advanced.
Certificate selected. MyTel will use it to connect to your SIP account over TLS.
Use TLS and a SIP server hostname dedicated to one account in MyTel. The server hostname must match the SIP account domain.
Enter the password for this .p12 or .pfx file.
Remove the certificate from this phone? Fully close and reopen MyTel to end the previous TLS connection.
Could not open this certificate. Check the file, its password, and the certificate expiration date.
Could not update the certificate on this phone. Check the SIP account settings and try again.
Certificate stored. Reconnect MyTel if needed.
